en.title: Exactly k Proper Suffix Rotations
en.description:
In each step, choose a non-empty proper suffix and move it to the front of the string; the string must become the target after exactly k steps. Different sequences of cut points are counted separately, even if the string is periodic. Output the answer modulo 10⁹+7.

The input/output protocol was compiled independently by this site; upstream solutions are not executed.
en.input: Three lines: src, target, and k. Each string has length 2..1000, 1≤k≤10⁶, and characters are a..z.
en.output: Output the single integer required by the problem.
en.explanation: The answers to the three public examples are, in order: 2; 9; 0. All examples have been verified by independent small-scale enumeration or state search.
hints: Count the c positions among all n rotation positions that match the target, then use fast exponentiation of a two-state (match/mismatch) matrix.
